name: engine_data_coherence_derating
title: Engine data-sheet coherence check and ISO 3046-type derating (worked example)
summary: Worked example (MCI instructor solution): checks the internal coherence of a 5-cylinder diesel data sheet (swept volume, piston speed, shaft power, charge-air cooler duty, exhaust flow), computes thermal efficiency, excess air, volumetric and compressor isentropic efficiencies, then derates the power to the site conditions (ISO 3046-type law) and estimates the CO2 emissions per distance.

origin.course: Moteurs à combustion interne (MCI, ULiège), June 2019 exam, instructor solution (tag RD); published as an example

verification.summary: Compared with the EES stored solution of resolultion_RD.EES: 72 common variables, 5 differ (rtol=0.001), the absolute air h and s (reference-state offset, cancels in epsilon_s_cp); excluding them the maximum relative difference is 9.82e-4 on Q_dot_air (cp of air, CoolProp vs EES tables).
verification.reference: EES stored solution of ~/Nextcloud/thermo_models/MCI_REMIDICKES/MCI/Examen/resolultion_RD.EES (72 names decoded by ees_extract.py; EES X9.721)
verification.notes: Excluded from the maximum (named in the README): h_su_cp, h_ex_cp, h_ex_cp_s, s_su_cp, s_ex_cp_s (absolute enthalpy/entropy of ideal-gas Air, reference-state offset of CoolProp vs the EES air tables). The model solves square (72 equations, largest block 3) also from the default guesses; with the EES stored solution as .initials it takes 2 iterations.
